I added `removeItem(sku)` to `Cart` in `src/cart.ts:17`. I haven't run or tested it.

It removes every entry with that SKU, not just the first one. `addItem` doesn't merge duplicates, so one SKU can be in the cart more than once. If the SKU isn't in the cart, the method does nothing.

One thing I noticed but didn't change: `applyDiscount` adds each new percent to the existing one (`+=`). Two calls with 10 give a 20% discount, and discounts over 100% would make totals negative. If you meant the discount to be replaced instead, that needs a separate fix.
